asr.full_text: Hey everyone and welcome back to my channel. I'm doing a 500 subscriber giveaway. And the winner of the giveaway will be receiving a $25 Target gift card. I chose a Target gift card because I love Target and I know that you love Target too because Target is life. The rules to the giveaway are very simple. Rule number one is you have to be a subscriber. If you are not a subscriber already, be sure to go ahead and subscribe down below. Number two, you need to comment down below. And it can be something silly or something about yourself. Whatever you want. Just be sure to leave a comment. And the last thing number three is make sure that your subscriptions are public and that way I can verify that you are a subscriber as soon as I hit 500 I will go ahead and pick a random winner and I will message you and let you know that you have won and find out where I can send it your gift card to I just want to say thank you so much to all my subscribers y'all mean so much to me, and like I love reading all your comments that you leave all the time. When I read those it just completely makes my day so thank you so much! I wanted to give a quick background on myself and my channel. My husband and I live in South Dakota and I'm a stay at home mom to our three small boys. They are six, three and one. And when I first started my channel, it was just four weeks ago today, actually. And I had just started it as kind of like a hobby and I didn't expect it to grow this fast at all. But as soon as I made my first couple of videos, I realized, like, I just love it and I was having so much fun. And so I kept making them and right now, I am at 400, I think just over 400 subscribers today, and I'm just ... I know in the YouTube world that is not a whole lot, like that's still a really small channel but to me that just means so much that y'all have all just decided to subscribe to me, it just means so much. If you are new to my channel, like I said I'm a stay-at-home mom so much that y'all have all just decided to subscribe to me, it just means so much. If you are new to my channel, like I said I am a stay-at-home mom so anything that has to do with mom life can end up on my channel, but I like to do a lot of like, organization videos, cooking videos, cleaning. I like to give out tips and things that can help especially if you are a mom. I have a lot of different tips that I've found over the years. I also do a lot of hauls like it can be grocery hauls or décor hauls just whatever I'm doing i will kind of film that for y'all and share those things with you. I'm also planning to do some DIYs. So definitely stay tuned for everything. I have so much, I have this big book that I've just been filling up with ideas for videos so be sure to subscribe down below if you have not already and good luck on the giveaway! I will see you in our next video. Bye!

textual.context: Presented as a creator's giveaway promotion; the stated selection condition is reaching 500 subscribers and the winner is to be chosen randomly.
textual.potential_relevance: The promised gift card is linked to audience growth, commenting, and public subscription status, creating a reward-for-actions relationship for later context assessment.
textual.limitations: These records do not establish whether the gift card was delivered, whether the winner was selected fairly, or whether any personal information beyond public subscription status was requested.

visual.observation: A Target-branded gift card is shown, followed by on-screen entry-style instructions: “1. Subscribe,” “2. Comment Below,” and “3. Make Subscriptions Public (for verification).”
visual.context: The context appears to be a vlog-style video segment; promotion versus discussion is unclear from the sampled frames. The phrase “for verification” is visible next to making subscriptions public.
visual.potential_relevance: A visible gift card is presented near instructions asking viewers to subscribe, comment, and make subscriptions public for verification, creating an observable relationship between a potential reward and requested audience actions.
visual.limitations: The sampled frames do not show the full verbal explanation, eligibility terms, gift card value, winner-selection process, deadline, or whether any prize is actually awarded.

textual_context_notes.observation: The description states that the giveaway has closed and identifies the video as a winner video.

visual_context_notes.observation: The video branding reads “This Crazy Life” with lifestyle topics such as mom life, organization, cooking, hauls, DIYs, and decorating.
The end card thanks viewers for watching and shows a YouTube subscribe button plus a Facebook icon and handle “@thiscrazylifevlog.”

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents a channel milestone giveaway in which one winner will receive a $25 Target gift card after subscribing, commenting, and making subscriptions public for eligibility verification. The described content includes a closed giveaway and a referenced winner video, with no investment offer, payment requirement, credential request, or deceptive transaction flow.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary content is an ordinary giveaway promotion: a gift card is offered to one winner, and entry requires subscribing, commenting, and making subscriptions public for verification. The supplied evidence does not show a fee, external claim flow, credential request, or sensitive-data request.
